entry.title: 25 November 2026 Artifact Wave
entry.content:
The clogged drain holding up the Compose 1.13.0 stable release was cleared late last week, so those artifacts showed up in today’s scan.

In addition, statestore-datastore is now multiplatform:

  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-desktop
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-iosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-iossimulatorarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-js
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-linuxarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-linuxx64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-macosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-tvosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-tvossimulatorarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-wasm-js
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-watchosarm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-watchosdevicearm64
  • androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore-watchossimulatorarm64

Plus, we got some new Remote Compose artifacts and something for Nav3 that seems truly dynamic:

  • androidx.compose.remote:remote-creation-compose-android
  • androidx.compose.remote:remote-creation-compose-jvm
  • androidx.compose.remote:remote-generator
  • androidx.navigation3:navigation3-dynamic-features

Overall, we got around 900 artifact updates.

If you are in the United States, I hope that you have a Merry Thanksgiving! If you reside elsewhere, I hope you have a great day too!

entry.title: 18 November 2026 Artifact Wave
entry.content:
Well, this is awkward.

Google announced earlier today that the 2026.11.01 BOM was available and it has the stable 1.13.0 edition of Jetpack Compose. However, several hours later, none of that has been published on maven.google.com. See, for example, the stable BOM versions and the Compose Foundation versions. As I write this, the latest Compose Foundation is 1.13.0-rc01 and the latest stable BOM is 2026.09.00.

Presumably, that will be fixed in the coming days.

However, we did get a bit over 300 artifact updates, including a stable 1.7.0 of Jetpack Camera.

entry.title: 4 November 2026 Artifact Wave
entry.content:
This time, we got one new artifact group, androidx.web, containing a single artifact, androidx.web:web. This does not appear in the documentation, but the artifact description is:

Web is a collection of modern APIs that can be used with android.webkit and androidx.webkit.

Overall, we got just shy of 400 artifact updates.

entry.title: 28 October 2026 Artifact Wave
entry.content:
We got two new artifact groups this time around.

androidx.appstate.statestore contains a androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore artifact (with multiplatform support) and a androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore artifact (Android-only). According to the limited description:

AppState StateStore is a new library built on the Compose runtime that acts as a wrapper to provide custom integrations. The androidx.appstate.statestore artifact provides the library APIs and it also comes with a androidx.appstate.statestore:statestore-datastore artifact for state persistence. Developers can use StateStore to hoist their snapshot state into their application layer and the datastore integration to persist that state.

Similarly, androidx.appstate.transform conains a androidx.appstate.transform:transform artifact and a androidx.appstate.transform:transform-testing artifact, each with multiplatform support. This is described as:

AppState Transform is a new library built on the Compose runtime that allows for running a composition outside of your UI. The androidx.appstate.transform:transform artifact provides the library APIs and it also comes with a androidx.appstate.transform:transform-testing artifact for testing. Developers can use Transform to manage their composition anywhere within their app.

Also, androidx.media3:media3-effect-play-services is a new artifact.

Here are the overall artifact updates.

entry.title: 23 September 2026 Artifact Wave
entry.content:
We have a two new artifact groups, androidx.a2ui and androidx.a2ui.compose, which contain Google’s first official implementation of A2UI for Compose. There are a handful of artifacts in those groups:

  • androidx.a2ui:a2ui-engine:1.0.0-alpha01
  • androidx.a2ui:a2ui-model:1.0.0-alpha01
  • androidx.a2ui.compose:compose-runtime:1.0.0-alpha01
  • androidx.a2ui.compose:compose-ui:1.0.0-alpha01
  • androidx.a2ui.compose:compose-ui-testing:1.0.0-alpha01

Also, androidx.compose.material3:material3-a2ui is a new artifact, also presumably tied to A2UI.

(FWIW, I wrote a bit about A2UI for Compose over on my Pedal Assist Coding newsletter)

There is also a new androidx.test.backup group with two artifacts:

  • androidx.test.backup:backup:1.0.0-alpha01
  • androidx.test.backup:backup-host:1.0.0-alpha01

Soon, there should be a androidx.transition:transition-ktx:1.7.2 artifact release. That release seems to have been incomplete, as the POM file is missing.

In addition, we got over 500 new artifact versions this wave!
